Sara —

Thanks for the clear questions and the RFP. Quick answers up-front and a suggested follow-up path:

1) Billing unit: we offer two primary billing primitives on the hosted API for embeddings — per-vector and per-token-equivalent. For standard usage we quote per-vector pricing (i.e., cost per embedding generated). Per-token is used for custom token-accounting or where customers run tokenized pre-processing in our pipeline; we provide a conversion table for common models.

2) Dimensions: we price by dimensionality class rather than each exact vector dimension. Typical classes are: 512-d (low), 1k–1.5k (mid), and 3k+ (high). The higher classes reflect more compute and memory and are priced ~1.5x–2x relative to 512-d for the same vector count. If you need a custom dimension (e.g., 768), we map it to the nearest class for pricing or offer a custom quote for steady-state volumes.

3) Supported models: hosted API currently supports Redwood-embed-512, Redwood-embed-1536, and a selection of community models (open-embedding-small/med). Redwood-embed-1536 is our performance default for semantic search; it has higher tokenization overhead and yields larger vectors. I'll attach our short ratecard PDF and a compatibility matrix.

4) Discounts/commits: for initial numbers like ~500k texts/day (~15M vectors/month assuming 30 tokens average per doc), we can do tiered discounts: 10% at a 3-month commit, 18% at a 12-month commitment, and we can structure a higher-volume pilot allowance if you expect quick ramp. Exact thresholds depend on dimensions and latency SLOs.

Can we hop on a 30-min call tomorrow to walk the volume forecast and get to a draft SOW? If helpful I'll have Lauren (who runs pricing) join.

Best,

Sara —

Appreciate the forecast and the specificity. I reviewed the volume sheet and here is a concise commercial proposal (formal SOW to follow):

Pricing primitives (hosted embeddings):
- 512-class: $0.0008 / vector (baseline)
- 768/1536-class (mid): $0.0016 / vector (1536 maps to mid class; 768 treated as mid-class for pricing unless you require a custom build)
- High (3k+): $0.0028 / vector

Discount schedule (applies to list vector rate above, volume evaluated monthly):
- <50M vectors/mo: no commit discount
- 50M–150M vectors/mo: 10% off list with 3-month commit
- 150M–400M vectors/mo: 18% off list with 12-month commit
- >400M vectors/mo: 25% off list, enterprise terms (SLA and reserved capacity)

Notes on token vs vector billing:
- We publish the tokenizer and the per-model token->vector mapping in the compatibility matrix (included in the ratecard). For most customers the per-vector table is simpler; per-token billing is available for custom preprocessing pipelines and will be converted using the published mapping.

Latency and throughput (hosted tier, Redwood-embed-1536):
- Typical single-vector p95 latency: 70–120ms (varies by batch size and region)
- Batch throughput: 200–400 vectors/sec per serving shard; autoscaling on hosted tier handles bursty demand.
- We can include an explicit latency SLO (<200ms p95) in the SOW if you opt for reserved capacity or a premium SLA.

Pilot commercial suggestion (to match your ramp):
- 3-month pilot: 15M vectors/mo at 10% discount; includes one month of pilot credits to validate latency and quality.
- If you convert to a 12-month commit with the ramp to 180M/mo, the 18% tier would apply once you cross 150M/mo.
